instruction: Observe the object placement order, remember it, then place the corresponding objects into the basket in the same order.

arguments.note: The demonstration has finished with all five objects in its basket. Begin orienting the left hand downward for the phone.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The first rotation landed accurately. Finish the downward grasp orientation before approaching the phone.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Move above the blue phone, first in the remembered sequence, keeping clearance for visual alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 17 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wrist view shows the phone forward and slightly left of the jaws. Correct that offset while descending to a safe approach height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone is centered between the jaws in the wrist view. Lower toward its grasp height without closing yet.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The head view shows the jaws still forward of the phone. Shift back over its body at the current clearance height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws now overlap the phone in the head view. Make a small lateral alignment and approach its sidewalls.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone body is between the jaws. Lower four millimetres and close around it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The gripper has closed against the phone rather than fully shut. Lift vertically to verify and clear the basket rim.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 13 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone lifted successfully. Carry it over the empty policy basket on the left.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone is above the basket interior. Lower it inside the rim before releasing the first object.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone has settled inside the policy basket. Open the hand and withdraw before taking the green watch second.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The first object remains in the basket. Move above the green watch, the second demonstrated object, leaving the other three untouched.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The long reach was refused without motion. Use a lower intermediate pose before approaching the watch.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The left planner cannot reach the watch approach. Prepare the nearby right arm instead.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Finish turning the right gripper downward for the watch.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Approach above the green watch using the right arm, which is on its side of the table.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wrist image places the watch to the right of the jaw center. Align over its front case and descend toward its sides.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The watch case is nearly centered. Make the final lateral correction and approach the case height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The watch case is centered between the jaws. Lower four millimetres and grasp it as the second object.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws have closed on the watch. Lift it clear of the table before carrying it toward the left basket.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The watch is securely lifted. Bring it to the shared central workspace for transfer to the left arm, avoiding an unreachable cross-table reach.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 21 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lower the watch at the clear central transfer spot, still keeping it above the tabletop.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Approach the table slowly with the held watch before opening at the transfer spot.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Release the watch onto the central tabletop for the left arm; this is only a transfer, not a basket placement.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The last 3 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The watch is resting at the transfer location. Lift the empty right hand clear.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 13 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Move the right hand back to its home position to clear the left arm's approach.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Approach the transferred watch with the left hand while starting to restore the right wrist's home orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 24 waypoints (1.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The watch is aligned below the left hand. Descend to the previous successful grasp height and finish returning the right wrist home.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Adjust a few millimetres toward the settled watch and close the left jaws around its case.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The left jaws are holding the watch. Lift vertically for its second-in-sequence basket placement.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The watch slipped back onto the table during lifting. Reopen and approach its slightly shifted position for a deeper grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 17 waypoints (0.7s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lower toward the watch's lower sidewall to avoid another shallow grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Close at the deeper watch grasp after a final four-millimetre descent.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lift the deeper watch grasp and check that it stays between the jaws.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The watch is now securely lifted. Carry it over a clear area of the left basket beside the phone.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 27 waypoints (1.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The watch is over the basket interior beside the phone. Lower within the rim and release it as the second placement.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The last 4 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Phone and watch are in the basket in order. Raise and angle the left wrist forward to extend its reach toward the third object, the black device.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Approach the black rectangular device with the angled wrist, keeping clearance above the remaining objects.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 33 waypoints (1.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The black device is beneath the angled gripper. Descend toward its sidewalls, leaving a small clearance for inspection.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Center the black device slightly more precisely and lower to its upper sidewalls.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The device is centered within the jaw opening. Lower a few millimetres and close for the third pickup.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The black device is held between the jaws. Lift it clear before carrying it to the basket.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The black device lifted successfully. Carry it above the rear portion of the policy basket for the third placement.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 25 waypoints (1.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lower the black device into the clear rear basket area and release it third, after the phone and watch.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The last 3 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The black device is in the basket, completing the first three placements. Lift clear before picking the plush rabbit fourth.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Move above the plush rabbit's broad head and torso for the fourth pickup, leaving the gold truck for last.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The rabbit's head is centered below the jaws. Descend toward its sides while keeping the ears clear.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws surround the rabbit's head. Make a short final descent and close gently through the gripper command.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws have closed on the rabbit's head. Lift vertically, allowing clearance for its hanging body.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 13 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The rabbit is securely lifted. Carry its head over the basket's left-center area so its body also stays within the rim.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 21 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The rabbit has shifted downward into the basket under the hand. Open now to leave it as the fourth object without pressing on the contents.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The rabbit is settling after release. Approach above the gold truck, the final object, while checking that the rabbit remains in the basket.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 23 waypoints (0.9s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The rabbit bounced out behind the basket, so the truck must wait. Return to recover the fourth object before completing the sequence.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 22 waypoints (0.9s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The rabbit lies left of the hand after settling. Align over the back of its head and descend for a more secure grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The back of the rabbit's head is now between the jaws. Correct slightly left and approach its lower sides for secure retention.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Close around the rabbit's head after a final small descent, aiming for a deeper hold than the first attempt.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The deeper rabbit grasp is closed. Lift it above the basket rim for a controlled replacement.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The rabbit remains securely held. Move it over the basket center with its body directed into the basket rather than across the rim.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 29 waypoints (1.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The rabbit is contained over the basket interior. Lower it closer to the floor to avoid the previous bouncing release.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lower the rabbit farther inside the basket while its body remains clear of the rim.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The rabbit is now low inside the basket, supported among the contents. Release it without further downward pressure.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The last 3 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The rabbit has settled inside the basket. Withdraw vertically before collecting the gold truck last.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The first four objects remain in the basket. Approach the gold truck for the fifth and final placement.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 22 waypoints (0.9s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The truck is centered laterally. Move slightly forward and descend toward its body for a side grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The truck body is between the jaws. Lower four millimetres and close for the final pickup.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The truck is gripped across its body. Lift it clear of the table and basket rim.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The truck lifted successfully. Carry it over the open front portion of the basket, away from the rabbit and black device.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 30 waypoints (1.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The truck is over the basket's front interior. Lower it while keeping its extended body clear of the front rim.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The truck is fully within the basket footprint and close to the floor. Release it as the fifth object.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The last 5 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: All five corresponding objects are now in the policy basket. Lift the empty hand clear before returning home.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: All five objects remain in the basket and the demonstration basket is untouched. Return the left grasp point to its starting position.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Restore the left wrist's starting orientation with its gripper open. Both arms will then be home with all five objects left in the copied sequence.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.
